lines.text: Who murdered the crown prince of the Cholas?
Around nine sixty nine, Aditya Karikalan, heir to the throne, was killed.
Chola records boast he had already killed the Pandya king, Vira Pandya, in battle.
lines.caps: Chola *records | boast | he had *killed | the *Pandya king | in *battle.

lines.text: Then he was gone. No record says exactly how.

lines.text: And for years, it seems, nobody was punished.
Later, the crown went to a cousin, Uttama Chola, not to Aditya's younger brother.

lines.text: Only when that brother ruled as Rajaraja the First did an inscription at Udaiyarkudi name the killers, royal officers, and take their families' lands.
